gen-flavors-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Stubby, cheeky, loud: Flavors hammers out diagonals as hefty as its stems, while Sofia Sans Condensed trails behind in friendly, open-ended curves. Flavors is built to shout; the sans just talks.
gen-flavors-gf-spline-sans-mono: Flavors arrives towering and whimsical, with diagonals as hefty as its stems. Spline Sans Mono then takes over in bold, fixed-width letters, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals, so a long page reads like tidy, typewritten code.
gen-flavors-gf-strait: Chunky and playful, with strokes drawn like taut string. Flavors sets that towering, commanding mood up top, and Strait follows underneath with big round lowercase bowls that soften the whole page.
gen-flavors-gf-tiny5: Tiny5 reads clean and approachable, though its ascenders look stubby because the body runs so tall. Flavors is the one for swagger, with bowls and stems at matching weight; Tiny5 is the one for quiet, plain sans text.
gen-flavors-gf-truculenta: Flavors towers, with a lowercase like a stubby carpenter's pencil stroke. Up top it brings whimsy and command, while Truculenta packs its sans-serif letters into a compact, tall-bodied line that gets on with the reading.
gen-flavors-gf-ubuntu: Ubuntu reads modern and professional, its lofty lowercase band lifting every line of the plain sans text. Flavors does the loud work, bending cable-like strokes into shapes; Ubuntu does the steady talking.
gen-flavors-gf-victor-mono: Loud meets loose: Flavors stacks its towering, whimsical letters above monospace text that looks magnified, with bowls left open on one side. Victor Mono then spaces its glyphs generously, giving the heavy heading plenty of room to breathe.
gen-flavors-gf-viga: Neutral is the word for Viga, a plain sans with hairline-free strokes and capitals that barely rise above their neighbors. Under Flavors' towering swagger, a long page would read smoothly.
gen-flavors-gf-voces: Voces reads tall and professional, with a close ratio between its stems and hairlines that keeps the sans tidy. A long page would move along gently, with only a mild shift in weight from stem to serif.
gen-flavors-gf-winky-rough: Whimsical describes Flavors best, a wire-like monoline skeleton with a towering lowercase, set over Winky Rough, a sans whose body height nearly matches its capitals. Contrast is their strongest quality.
